user.title: Connect to Harman Kardon AVR 1710
user.description: Enter your receiver's IP address. Both the proprietary TCP:10025 control API (power/source) and the DLNA/UPnP port 8080 API (volume/mute/transport) are used automatically.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot connect to the receiver on either network API. Check the IP address and that the receiver is powered on.
